npcs.name: Mara
npcs.role: Innkeeper of the Oakshade inn and informal voice of the Village Council
goals: Keep Oakshade's travelers safe and paying
Find out what is happening near the Emberwood Ruins
Avoid open conflict with the Ashen Band while the Council figures out what to do
knowledge: Knows most villagers by name and tracks who is missing and who is back.
Heard that a Council scout has not returned from a trip toward the ruins.
Does not trust the hooded traveler Corvin and has noticed he watches newcomers.
Knows the blacksmith, Harlan, has been buying strange metal from travelers.
npcs.relationship_summary: Has never met the player before. Treats outsiders politely but guardedly until they prove themselves.

npcs.name: Corvin
npcs.role: Hooded traveler at the inn; possible scout or informant with his own agenda
personality: willing to pay for discreet help
goals: Find out what the Ashen Band is pulling out of the Emberwood Ruins
Avoid being identified by the Village Council
Recruit an outsider to do the dangerous part of his investigation
npcs.disposition: neutral, attentive, hopeful when approached quietly
knowledge: Claims to have followed the Ashen Band for weeks before coming to Oakshade.
Has a partial map of the Emberwood Ruins he is willing to share for a price.
Will not speak openly in Mara's presence and prefers conversations away from the bar.
Knows the Council has lost at least one scout but has not told anyone in the village.
npcs.relationship_summary: Has been watching the player since they walked in. Will approach if the player seems capable and discreet.

npcs.name: Harlan
npcs.role: Village blacksmith and reluctant middleman for outside traders
personality: loyal to the village but short on money
slow to lie but quick to change the subject
goals: Keep his forge running through a bad season
Avoid being blamed for buying metal that might have come from the ruins
Protect his family from anything that looks like Ashen Band trouble
knowledge: Has been buying unusual metal from passing travelers at a suspicious discount.
Suspects but will not admit that some of it came from the Emberwood Ruins.
Knows the Ashen Band has used at least one of his buyers as a courier.
Will sell basic gear to the player and trade information if pressed gently.
npcs.relationship_summary: Treats the player as a potential customer first. Will open up only if the player does not threaten his livelihood.
